description: Download a single attachment from an email (folder + uid + attachment filename/contentId, as listed by imap_get_email). Images are returned inline for viewing; PDFs are saved and their text is extracted inline (extractText); other files are saved to the shared downloads directory (or savePath). Use when the user wants the actual file contents, not just the message body.

accountId.description: Account ID (from imap_list_accounts). Optional if accountName is given or only one account is configured.

accountName.description: Account name instead of accountId. Optional if accountId is given or only one account is configured.

extractText.description: For PDFs, extract and return text content inline

filename.description: Attachment filename or contentId as listed by imap_get_email. Matched exactly first, then Unicode-normalized (NFC/NFD spellings of umlauts and accents are treated as equal); a contentId may be given with or without its angle brackets

savePath.description: Optional file path to save the attachment to. If not provided, files are saved to the shared downloads directory.

name: imap_download_attachment
